This post is pretty much copy&paste from Reddit, but why not gain some exposure here as well.

It's been about 10 months since I made this post on Reddit proposing a collaborative effort to develop a political system more fit for the future and setting in motion the wheels for change. I've yet to finish making a song though, lol. There's a better logo though, not too different from the lazy one I posted last time (an .xcf file of it is available on the Wiki so you can improve/change it).

Anyway, the site's pretty much ready if anyone is interested and has been up for a little while (it's an i2p link, so you need i2p to visit it): revolution.i2p

It's basically just a Wiki, which will be used to make the blueprints of this supposedly improved democratic system. You'll have to have me make an account for you if you want to contribute (just send me your desired username to TheRevolutionary@i2pmail.org and I'll send you back a password and confirmation); darknets can be prone to some dark content, so I'm just being extra safe. I'm not an expert on politics by any means, so I won't be good with details. I have laid a very basic framework to build upon though, which might turn out to be quite flawed, but at least it's a start. The site could become a hub for a future revolutionary movement, but for now it's just focused on developing a democratic political system hopefully without some of the flaws of the current ones. Of course, some discussions might as well be had here as well, of which fruits I can draw from and add to the wiki myself.

In time I might start developing some of the software which will be pivotal to making this system function reliably, or contribute to already existing software.

I'm also still active on IRC2P's #revolution from time to time, but sadly I haven't seen much activity in there. Although I could have done a better job reaching out to other like-minded communities and try to advertise the site/idea (which likely isn't as original as I'd like to think).

Let me know what you think and whether I'm wasting my time or not with this.
revolution.i2p a site for discussing changes to the current democratic model

I'll still be semi-active on IRC2P if nothing else.
